# OTA updates / OTA-обновления

How an installed system updates itself (`hs-update`, menu **System → Updates**):

1. `hs-update check` downloads `ota-manifest.txt` from the newest GitHub release
   (`https://github.com/Ashlorik/HomeserverOS/releases/latest/download/ota-manifest.txt`).
2. `hs-update install` downloads the package named in the manifest, verifies its SHA-256, backs up the current system,
   applies the update, writes the new kernel to the boot partition. `hs-update rollback` returns to the backup.

## The manifest (generated by CI on every release, do not edit by hand)

```
version=0.5a
package=homeserver-v0.5a-update.tar.xz
sha256=<checksum of the package>
size=<bytes>
min_version=0.4a
notes=<first line of ota/notes/0.5a.md>
```

## Releasing an update

1. Bump `overlay/etc/hs-version`.
2. Write what changed in `ota/notes/<version>.md` (first line = short summary shown to the user).
3. `git tag v<version> && git push origin v<version>` - CI builds the images, the update package and the manifest and attaches them to the release.

Pre-releases are not served by the `latest` URL; mark a release as *latest* when it is ready for everybody.
The update package never touches settings, users, SSH keys, `/root`, `/home` and `/var`.
